notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two lands.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Cast Infernal Plunge by paying {R} and sacrificing a creature.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Infernal Plunge.
Resolve the copy of Infernal Plunge, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
